question: Renowned for her Odissi dancing style, _______ is an eminent Indian Classical dancer. She founded the Centre for Indian Classical Dances in New Delhi and was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 1992.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is a renowned Indian classical dancer, particularly known for her Odissi dance style.
 
• She founded the Centre for Indian Classical Dances in New Delhi and was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 1992.
 
• Known for: Odissi and Bharatanatyam dancing styles
 
• Awards: Padma Bhushan (1992), Padma Vibhushan (2003), Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1987), Kalidas Samman (2006), Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship (2018)
 
• Other accomplishments: Founded the Centre for Indian Classical Dances (CICD) in New Delhi in 1977, nominated by the President of India to become a Member of the parliament, Rajya Sabha, social activist involved in women's empowerment and environmental conservation
 
• Born: April 30, 1944 in Bombay (now Mumbai)
 
• Trained under: Kelucharan Mohapatra and Hema Malini

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mallika Sarabhai
 
 
• Mallika Sarabhai is an acclaimed Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dancer.
 
• She has performed extensively in India and internationally, earning a reputation for her exceptional artistry and innovation in classical dance forms.
 
• Beyond her contributions to dance, Mallika is a prominent social activist.
 
• She uses her art to address social issues, promote gender equality, and raise awareness about various societal challenges.
 
• She has been actively involved in campaigns for women’s rights and environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• Hema Malini
 
 
• Hema Malini, known as the "Dream Girl" of Bollywood, is a legendary actress with a prolific career spanning several decades.
 
• She has appeared in numerous successful films, earning critical acclaim and numerous awards for her performances in movies like "Sholay" and "Seeta Aur Geeta."
 
• Hema Malini is also an active politician.
 
• She is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has served as a Member of Parliament (MP).
 
• She works on various social and cultural initiatives and has been involved in developmental projects in her constituency.
 
 
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale
 
 
• Rukmini Devi Arundale is credited with reviving and popularizing the classical dance form of Bharatanatyam.
 
• At a time when the art was stigmatized, she helped reclaim it with dignity and reformed its presentation.
 
• She established the Kalakshetra Foundation in Chennai, an academy devoted to the preservation and teaching of Bharatanatyam and other Indian classical arts.
 
• Rukmini Devi was a passionate advocate for animal rights and welfare.
 
• She served as the chairperson of the Animal Welfare Board of India and worked tirelessly towards the enactment and enforcement of laws aimed at protecting animals.
